name: CommonsenseQA
intro: CommonsenseQA 是常识问答 benchmark，报告中用于评估模型基于常识知识进行选择和推理的能力。
build_method: ConceptNet子图采样, 众包出题与干扰项, 双人验证
build_method_en: ConceptNet subgraph sampling, crowdsourced questions and distractors, two-worker validation
intro_en: CommonsenseQA is a commonsense question-answering benchmark used in reports to evaluate selection and reasoning over commonsense knowledge.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1811.00937. CommonsenseQA filters ConceptNet to 236,208 usable triplets, then groups three targets sharing a source concept and relation, yielding about 43K candidate question sets. AMT workers write three discriminative questions per set without obvious surface clues; only workers with at least 75% verified questions remain. Each question adds one same-relation ConceptNet distractor and one plausible worker-authored distractor for five choices. Two disjoint workers verify each question, keeping it if at least one answers correctly and filtering 15%. Optional Google context contains 100 snippets for each of five candidate queries. From 16,242 formulations, 12,247 final questions use the harder primary random 80/10/10 split and test accuracy.
